profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Highly motivated, detail-oriented Software Engineer with a generalist mindset and 10+ years of industry experience. IT Experience in all phases of SDLC including Design, development, integration, implementation, coding, testing, maintenance and Mentoring in various Client/ Server, multi-tiered web based application. 

Technologies:
Java, J2EE, Spring, JPA/Hibernate, JSP, Servlets, JDBC, Web-services, SOAP, REST, HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, AJAX, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Tomcat server, GWT, AWS SQS, Drupal, Wordpress,AWS Services, Databricks, SQL, NOSQL

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Defining Roadmap, Stories and Execution plan
- Defining Standards for the SDLC 
- Developing Features required for the ML Models to predict better
- Setting up data pipeline for consumption by the ML Models
- Laying out Architecture for faster development and retraining model
- Orchestrated with Engineers for Model Serving, Model Triaining & Inference
- Migrating Monolith Application into Micro service Architecture
- Creating Architecture & Stories for Legacy System Improvements.
- Directing Offshore Teams
- Databricks for transforming and processing data for further analysis by Machine learning platform
- Accomplished Feature Store for Data Analytics
- Orchestrated with the products and customers to understand their need and providing end to end solution.
- Reducing AWS Cost for VPC Endpoints
- Working with the team to define the OKRs
- 80% Cost Reduction by analyzing data usage patterns to adjust read and write capacity units, resulting in substantial cost savings.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon EC2 · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Core Java · Data Structures · EMAIL SE · Eclipse · HTML · JDBC · JSON · JSP · Java · Java Enterprise Edition · Machine Learning · Microservices · MySQL · OOP · SQL · PostgreSQL · Servlets · Spring · Web Applications · Azure Databricks · Python (Programming Language) · Perl · Dynamo

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leading project for new vendor with Millions of Customer Base and Collaborated with different teams to deliver High-quality application as per Business Logic.
- Designed data driven application which renders data based on the
configuration reducing human errors, increasing productivity and making
system more compliant
- Decreased application load time speed by 10% after optimizing queries and using pagination.
- Modularization of code improving readability ,manageability and re-usage of code. Helped fixing the bugs easily and reducing development efforts.
- Implementation of Major Features like Processing of Member/Claims Data, Authorizations and Workflow Enhancements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Involved in end-to-end development of Middleware API for claims system, which transforms
RESTFul request/response between PBM(Pharmacy Benefit Management) system and vendors.
- Design and developed RESTFul and SOAP services for vendors to access the data of Internal System.
- Contributed Software development expertise in the development of product through SDLC, from requirement gathering through post development support.
- Developed project for generating POJO's and service side code based on the table Schema.
- Involved in End-to-End (Full-Stack) development of the feature and functionalities.
- Involved in development and Implementation of business application using Java/J2EE technology.
- Coordinated with product and config resources to enhance application configuration system.
- Developed the middle tier and view components using Spring frameworks.
- Used Spring JDBC template with hibernates to access the data from the database.
- Using GWT for converting Java Source into JavaScript.

positions.title: SAP SD Consultant
positions.description:
- Configured Enterprise Structure: Create company code, Sales Organization, Defining and assignment of business structure.
- Worked with the Business Team to Identify the Customer Master and the Material Master Field required as per the Business. 
- Learned Migration of the Material Master Data and Customer Master Data with the help of LSMW (Legacy System Migration Workbench) tool. 
- Involved in Interfacing company logistic handling to a third party Vendors. 
- Created mapping documents required for interface between Third party Software and SAP. 
- Used JCo connector for the connection between the Third Party Vendor and SAP.

positions.title: ITC (IT Consultant )Student Assistant
positions.locationName: 5151 State University Drive, Los Angeles, CA-90032
positions.description:
-  Updating the ECST (College of Engineering, Computer Science and Technology) Website.
-  Troubleshooting Hardware/ Software Problems.
-   Contribution in Migrating the website from PHP to Drupal.
-  Troubleshooting Network Problems.
-  Providing Technical support to Faculty, Staff and Students.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer (Intern)
positions.description:
-	Handling data provided by the sales and finance department.
-	Maintaining 35 system and server.
-	Learned about the remote order processing and uploading system.
-	Troubleshooting of remote systems in other offices.

projects.title: Tweet Analysis
projects.description:
- Collection of Data using Tweet API
- Extracting the required Data using Hadoop Map Reduce.
- Analyze and Visualize the Data based on the analysis in Python.
Platform: Python

projects.title: Academic Journal Website
projects.description:
- Designed and Developed Website for the Research Papers.
- Implemented Various feature from the Submission till the approval of the Research paper
Platform: ColdFusion, My SQL

publications.title: Unified Operating System
publications.publisher: International Journal Of Soft Computing and Engineering · May 10, 2012
